overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（11 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）。方法上以实验方法、均衡模型为主。来源分布：arXiv（9 篇）、OpenAlex（3 篇）。

papers.title: Large language model developments
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Large language models (LLMs) are generative artificial intelligence (AI) models trained with vast amounts of data and context, and excel at processing, understanding and generating human language, using transformer models to learn statistical relationships between tokens. LLMs are a subset of transformer models, and hence are closely related but not interchangeable. Given the ‘explosion’ of LLM research, the challenge is tracking emerging developments and matching LLMs to applications. This paper reviews LLM developments with the aim of understanding the underlying models’ computational strengths and weaknesses, building on previous work focusing on LLM optimization (Sharkey & Treleaven 2025 Optimising large language models: taxonomy and techniques. SSRN Scholarly Paper no. 5278456. Rochester, NY: SSRN). We find that despite their power, LLMs (transformers) face several key challenges. These include: (i) computational complexity and resource requirements—training and deploying large models is extremely costly and slow, and energy consumption is a concern; (ii) understanding long sequences and dependencies—even with enhancements, models can struggle with very long-range dependencies or context lengths beyond their window (e.g. maintaining coherence in a long document), which reflects the more fundamental absence of continual learning; (iii) interpretability and bias—it remains difficult to interpret why a model produces a given output, and models can inadvertently amplify biases present in training data; and (iv) optimization challenges, including fine-tuning for specific tasks without overfitting or losing generality and ensuring efficient inference (latency, the delay before a response is completed) for real-time applications. In summary, this review focuses on architectural, optimization and interpretability developments in LLMs. It does not aim to provide a systematic benchmark comparison, exhaustive implementation details or empirical performance evaluation, which are covered extensively elsewhere. The authors are committed to updating this review aligned to constant changes in the technology; please reach out with any additions.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
大型语言模型（LLMs）是一种基于生成式人工智能（AI）的模型，通过大量数据和上下文进行训练，能够在处理、理解和生成人类语言方面表现出色。它们利用Transformer架构来学习语言符号之间的统计关系。LLMs属于Transformer模型的一个子集，因此两者之间存在密切联系，但不可互换。鉴于LLM研究领域的快速发展，当前面临的挑战是如何跟踪新兴的研究成果，并将这些模型有效地应用于实际场景中。本文旨在回顾LLM的发展历程，深入探讨其计算能力的优势与局限性，同时延续以往关于LLM优化方面的研究（参见Sharkey & Treleaven 2025年的论文《优化大型语言模型：分类与技术》（SSRN学术论文编号5278456，纽约罗切斯特：SSRN）。研究发现，尽管LLMs具备强大的性能，但仍存在若干关键问题：  
（1）计算复杂性与资源需求：训练和部署大型模型成本高昂、耗时较长，且能源消耗问题日益突出；  
（2）处理长序列与依赖关系：即便经过优化，模型仍难以处理超长范围的依赖关系或超出其处理范围的上下文信息（例如在长文档中保持文本连贯性），这反映了模型缺乏持续学习能力的问...。研究方法：大语言模型、Transformer 模型、优化方法。

papers.title: EMSA-YOLO: An Enhanced Multiscale Attention Model for Pavement Defect Detection
papers.venue: Journal of Transportation Engineering Part B Pavements
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Accurate and efficient identification of pavement defects is crucial for reducing traffic accident rates and ensuring the safety of road users’ lives and property. To effectively address the multiscale issue in pavement defect detection and significantly improve the detection accuracy of pavement defects, this study takes the YOLOv8 model as the basic framework. A new detection model is designed through targeted improvements, which is named Enhanced Multiscale Attention-YOLO (EMSA-YOLO), which integrates multiscale attention mechanisms with large-target feature extraction capabilities. Firstly, to enhance the extraction of defect features across multiple spatial scales, the EMSA module is designed to expand the receptive field and incorporate multiscale contextual information through the application of a learned weight matrix. Secondly, DySample is employed to optimize the upsampling process in the neck network, yielding clearer fused feature images and enhancing the detection accuracy of small-sized potholes. Finally, we add a new P6 large target detection layer to expand the receptive field and capture multiscale features, which enables the model to capture deeper semantic features and improve the detection of longitudinal and transverse cracks. Experimental results on the RDD2022 dataset demonstrate that the EMSA-YOLO achieves 84.1% mAP@50 and 57.5% mAP@50-95, outperforming the baseline by 2.1% and 1.7%, respectively. Significant accuracy improvements are observed in three critical defect categories: transverse crack with a 2.4% increase, alligator crack with a 4.8% increase, and potholes with a 1.4% increase compared to the baseline performance.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
准确高效地识别路面缺陷对于降低交通事故发生率、保障道路使用者的生命和财产安全至关重要。为有效解决路面缺陷检测中的多尺度问题并显著提升检测精度，本研究以YOLOv8模型为基础框架，通过针对性改进设计了一种新的检测模型——增强型多尺度注意力-YOLO（EMSA-YOLO）。该模型融合了多尺度注意力机制与大规模目标特征提取能力。首先，通过引入EMSA模块扩展感受野并运用学习得到的权重矩阵整合多尺度上下文信息，从而增强不同空间尺度下缺陷特征的提取能力；其次，采用DySample技术优化颈部网络中的上采样过程，获得更清晰的融合特征图像，进而提高对小型坑洞的检测精度；最后，新增P6大规模目标检测层以扩大感受野并捕捉多尺度特征，使模型能够捕捉更深层次的语义信息，提升对纵向和横向裂缝的检测效果。在RDD2022数据集上的实验结果表明，EMSA-YOLO的mAP@50指标达到84.1%，mAP@50-95指标达到57.5%，分别比基线模型提高了2.1%和1.7%。在三种关键缺陷类别上，检测精度均有显著提升：横向裂缝的检测精度提高了2.4%，鳄鱼裂缝提高了4.8%，坑洞提高了1.4%。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Dull, Dirty, Dangerous? Working Conditions and the Limits of Occupational AI Exposure
papers.abstract: Automation is often justified as relief from dull, dirty, and dangerous work. I examine how these conditions relate to occupational AI exposure using 21 O*NET items across 754 US occupations. Higher exposure is associated with lower condition scores under a large language model (LLM) measure and AI Occupational Exposure (AIOE), with equal occupation weights and employment weights. Adjustment for physical demands, required education, training and experience, and wages reduces the composite association. The adjusted confidence intervals include zero for LLM exposure and remain below zero for AIOE. Separating repetition from restricted discretion also changes what the combined Dull score conveys. These comparisons show how item groupings and occupational characteristics shape the interpretation of exposure estimates. Occupational profiles offer a starting point for selecting contrasting research settings. Establishing desired automation or realized relief requires evidence about workers' preferences and specific interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】自动化常被视为一种解脱，能够让人们摆脱枯燥、肮脏且危险的工作。本文通过分析754种美国职业中21项O*NET职业分类标准（O*NET items），探讨了这些工作条件与职业人工智能（AI）暴露程度之间的关系。研究发现，在使用大型语言模型（LLM）和人工智能职业暴露度（AIOE）进行评估时，职业人工智能暴露程度较高的职业，其工作条件评分较低（评估时均考虑了职业权重和就业权重）。在调整了工作体力要求、所需教育水平、培训经历以及工资等因素后，这种关联程度有所减弱；调整后的置信区间显示，对于人工智能暴露而言，其关联系数可能为零，而对于人工智能职业暴露度而言，该系数仍低于零。此外，将重复性劳动与自主决策受限的因素区分开来，也会改变综合评估结果的含义。这些比较结果表明，职业分类标准的划分方式及职业特征会直接影响对人工智能暴露程度的解读。职业特征为选择不同的研究对象提供了参考依据。要确定自动化带来的预期效益或实际缓解效果，需要掌握有关工人偏好及具体干预措施的相关证据。。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: Regression with Many Generated Controls
papers.abstract: We consider linear regression when some covariates are endogenous, a variable sufficient to control for endogeneity exists but is latent, and the practitioner can generate many proxies for the latent control. For instance, one could cheaply but imperfectly impute the latent control using different AI/ML methods, each generating a different proxy. There are several options the practitioner might consider in this scenario: including all proxies or factors computed from the proxies as controls, instrumental variables estimation, and some nonlinear variants thereof. We use a transparent model to derive the implicit estimand each approach targets, determine when these estimands recover the parameter of interest, and provide some practical recommendations. We show that with a sufficiently rich set of generated controls, practitioners can consistently estimate the parameter of interest without relying on validation data.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在某些协变量为内生变量、存在能够控制内生性的变量但该变量是潜在的、且研究者能够为该潜在控制变量生成多个替代指标时的线性回归问题。例如，可以使用不同的人工智能/机器学习方法来低成本但并不完美地估计该潜在控制变量，每种方法都会生成一个不同的替代指标。在这种情况下，研究者可以考虑几种方法：将所有替代指标或从这些替代指标计算出的因素都作为控制变量纳入模型；使用工具变量进行估计；或者采用一些非线性估计方法。我们通过一个透明的模型来明确每种方法所针对的隐含估计量，确定这些估计量何时能够准确反映感兴趣的参数，并提出一些实际建议。研究表明，只要生成的替代指标足够丰富，研究者就可以在不依赖验证数据的情况下一致地估计出感兴趣的参数。。研究方法：工具变量、回归分析。

papers.title: Formal divergence and legal relation preservation in Hong Kong judgment translation
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Legal English secures precision through dense qualificational syntax, and the evaluation of machine-translated legal texts often reads lower structural complexity as weaker legal precision. Whether formal simplification actually entails the loss of legally relevant relations has rarely been tested. This study examines the question in 57 Chinese-language Hong Kong judgments, comparing their official English translations with DeepSeek-V3.2 and ChatGPT output generated under a minimal prompt. Relative to the official translations, both model translations are shorter, lexically denser and markedly lower in subordination and complex nominal density. Their higher all-word lexical diversity lies in function words and has no counterpart in content words. A prespecified relation-level analysis then traced 192 source instances of qualification and scope marking into all three versions. Each version preserved the traced relations in over 97 % of its evaluable renderings, 98.06 % when the three versions are pooled. Of the eleven shifts, two occur in the official translations, five in DeepSeek and four in ChatGPT. The judgments with the greatest complex nominal divergence showed no larger model excess of shifts. The shifts that altered the reading of a judgment included changes in quantifier force, party coverage, attribution and restrictive scope, and the aggregate profile did not identify where they occurred. The findings separate formal simplification from relational loss. Legal precision in translated judgments is better evaluated through relational fidelity than through structural density, while corpus profiles remain appropriate for describing how production conditions package legal meaning.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
法律英语通过严谨的限定性句法结构确保语言的精确性；然而，对机器翻译的法律文本进行评估时，人们常认为其结构复杂性较低意味着法律精确性也较差。正式简化是否真的会导致法律相关意义的丧失，这一问题迄今鲜有研究。本研究以57份中文香港判决书为例，将其官方英文译本与DeepSeek-V3.2及ChatGPT在简单提示下生成的译本进行对比分析。与官方译本相比，这两种机器生成的译本在长度上更短、词汇使用更为密集，但从从句结构及复杂名词的使用来看精确性明显较低。尽管机器译本在总词汇多样性上更高（尤其是功能词方面），但在实义词层面并未表现出类似优势。随后，研究者对源文本中192处限定关系与范围标记进行了追踪分析，发现所有三个译本在超过97%的译文中均准确保留了这些关系（当三个译本合并分析时，这一比例上升至98.06%）。在所有11处语言变化中，2处出现在官方译本中，5处出现在DeepSeek译本中，4处出现在ChatGPT译本中。那些在复杂名词使用上差异最大的判决书，并未显示出机器译本在语言变化上的显著优势。这些语言变化主要体现在量词的意义强度、当事人涵盖范围、归属关系的表述以及限定范围的...。

papers.title: Stability and Perfection in Constrained Weighted Network Games
papers.abstract: We introduce a general framework of constrained weighted network formation in which agents allocate resources across coalitional interactions while facing feasibility constraints. More precisely, we allow arbitrary coalitions of agents to be assigned a continuous weight, and we incorporate both coalitional capacity constraints and individual budget constraints into the model. This framework extends the weighted network formation model of Bich and Morhaim by combining continuous interaction intensities with endogenous feasibility restrictions. Within this setting, we introduce a new notion of stability -- called coalitionwise stability -- extending pairwise stability to constrained network games. Under standard continuity and componentwise quasiconcavity assumptions on payoff functions, we establish the existence of coalitionwise stable networks. We then investigate refinements of stability inspired by the notion of perfect equilibrium introduced by Selten, and by the notion of perfect pairwise stability developed by Bich and Teteryatnikova for network games. The presence of feasibility constraints fundamentally alters the geometry of the feasible set, which no longer possesses a product structure. As a consequence, trembling-hand type refinements become substantially more delicate, since perturbations of some interactions may render other interactions infeasible. Nevertheless, we introduce constrained analogues of both the trembling-hand and perturbative notions of perfect stability considered by Bich and Teteryatnikova, and study their existence and their relationship. In particular, we show the equivalence between these trembling-hand and perturbative formulations under some componentwise monotonicity assumption.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一个受限加权网络形成的通用框架，在该框架中，代理在面临可行性约束的情况下，通过联盟互动来分配资源。更具体地说，我们允许为任意代理联盟分配一个连续的权重，并将联盟容量约束和个体预算约束纳入模型中。这一框架通过结合连续的互动强度与内生的可行性限制，扩展了Bich和Morhaim提出的加权网络形成模型。在此框架下，我们引入了一个新的稳定性概念——称为“联盟稳定性”，它将成对稳定性扩展到了受限网络博弈中。在收益函数满足标准连续性和逐组分拟凹性假设的前提下，我们证明了联盟稳定网络的存在性。随后，我们借鉴了Selten提出的完美均衡概念以及Bich和Teteryatnikova为网络博弈开发的完美成对稳定性概念，对稳定性进行了进一步研究。可行性约束的存在从根本上改变了可行集的几何结构，使得可行集不再具有乘积结构。因此，类似于“颤抖手”（trembling-hand）类型的稳定性改进变得更为复杂，因为某些互动的微小扰动可能导致其他互动变得不可行。尽管如此，我们仍然提出了受限条件下的“颤抖手”稳定性改进以及Bich和Teteryatnikova提出的完美稳定性改进的类似概念，并研究了它...。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: You Know What You Will Like: People Predict Their Own Ratings Better Than Recommender Systems
papers.abstract: Recommender systems usually learn what people want from what they have done. Platforms could also ask people directly, but asking is costly: 98.8% of the prompts in our data went unanswered. Theories of statistical prediction imply that a person's own forecast adds little to a recommender algorithm built from many people's behavior. Theories of dispersed knowledge imply that people hold information about their own taste that the data lack. We test the two with the MovieLens Beliefs dataset. In 2023-2024, a homepage prompt asked members how they expected to rate movies they said they had not seen. Of 26,020 such expectations, 551 from 277 members were followed by a rating at least a day later. We compare each expectation with four benchmarks: the platform's own predicted rating, two collaborative-filtering models (matrix factorization and an item neighborhood), and a stack trained on other members' outcomes. The trained models use each member's latest ratings. People predict their own ratings more accurately than all four benchmarks (correlation 0.69, against 0.34 for MovieLens and 0.54 to 0.59 for the trained recommenders). Added to all the machine forecasts and features, the expectation lowers out-of-sample mean squared error by 26%. The gain holds when models are trained on earlier expectations and tested on later ones. A member's earlier expectations about other movies do not replace the current one. In ordering a member's own movies, the trained recommenders are statistically indistinguishable from the person. On old, heavily rated movies, the machines do as well or better. The results reconcile the two theories: the crowd's data suffice where they are rich, and the person adds information about the specific item. We derive four design principles for preference elicitation and recommender evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】推荐系统通常通过分析用户的历史行为来预测他们的兴趣。虽然平台也可以直接询问用户的需求，但这种方式成本较高——在我们的数据中，98.8%的询问都未得到回应。统计预测理论认为，单个用户的预测对基于多人行为构建的推荐算法的辅助作用有限；而分散知识理论则指出，用户掌握着数据中缺失的关于自身偏好的信息。我们使用MovieLens Beliefs数据集对这两种观点进行了验证。在2023-2024年期间，网站主页向用户询问了他们对未观看电影的预期评分。在收到的26,020条预期评分中，仅有277名用户的551条评分在一天后得到了实际验证。我们将这些预期评分与四种基准结果进行了比较：平台自身的预测评分、两种协同过滤模型（矩阵分解和项目邻域模型），以及基于其他用户评分结果训练的推荐模型。这些推荐模型均使用了用户的最新评分数据。实验结果显示，用户对自己电影的评分预测准确度高于所有四种基准方法（用户预测与实际评分的相关性为0.69，而MovieLens模型的相关性为0.34，基于用户历史行为的推荐模型的相关性为0.54至0.59）。将用户的预期评分纳入机器预测结果后，模型的样本外均方误差降低了26%。...。

papers.title: Universal Nonexistence of Monotone Equilibrium in Multiunit Auctions with Risk Aversion
papers.abstract: We establish universal nonexistence results for monotone pure-strategy equilibrium in multiunit auctions with risk-averse bidders. Fix any number of bidders greater than one and any profile of strictly increasing concave utilities, with at least one strictly risk-averse bidder. Under uniform pricing, for every supply of at least three units, we construct independent, full-support type distributions under which neither lowest-winning-bid nor highest-losing-bid pricing admits an admissible monotone equilibrium. Under discriminatory pricing, we construct a finite supply and independent, full-support type distributions that preclude monotone pure-strategy equilibrium. We extend these results to all-pay auctions and finite bid grids.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们为具有风险厌恶投标人的多单位拍卖中的单调纯策略均衡建立了普遍性的不存在性定理。假设投标人数大于1，且所有投标人的效用函数均为严格递增的凹函数（其中至少有一名投标人是严格风险厌恶的）。在统一定价机制下，对于任何数量不少于3单位的商品供应，我们能够构造出独立的、具有完全支持性质的分布；在这些分布下，无论是最低中标价定价还是最高落标价定价，都无法形成满足条件的单调均衡。在歧视性定价机制下，我们同样能够构造出有限的供应量以及独立的、具有完全支持性质的分布，这些分布能够确保单调纯策略均衡的不存在性。此外，我们将这些结论扩展到了全支付拍卖和有限投标范围的情形中。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Does Frontier AI Strengthen Cyber Defense? Evidence from Project Glasswing
papers.abstract: Defenders and attackers race to find the same software flaws. I use the launch of Project Glasswing, which gave a small group of large US tech firms early access to Claude Mythos Preview, a model for finding software vulnerabilities, to study how access to frontier AI affects defenders, external researchers, and attackers. Using the universe of publicly disclosed vulnerabilities, I find that firms with access more than doubled their disclosures relative to Chinese and Russian tech firms without access, disclosed about 150 percent more high-impact vulnerabilities, and fixed reported flaws as quickly as before. As treated firms found more flaws themselves, external researchers, who sell their findings through bug bounties, reported about half as many vulnerabilities in treated firms' code and more in other firms' code, without leaving the market. There is no evidence that attackers exploited the additional vulnerabilities: the share exploited within a month of disclosure fell by about two thirds, mainly because a smaller share was already exploited when disclosed, while the number exploited did not change. Frontier AI helped defenders find and fix more flaws before attackers exploited them, but its restricted release creates an asymmetry in software security between firms in different countries.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】防御者和攻击者都在争相发现相同的软件漏洞。我以Project Glasswing的发布为例进行研究——该项目让美国几家大型科技公司提前获得了Claude Mythos Preview的试用权限，该工具用于检测软件漏洞。通过分析这一案例，我探讨了前沿人工智能技术对防御者、外部研究人员以及攻击者的影响。研究发现，拥有该技术的公司披露的漏洞数量是未获得该技术的中国和俄罗斯科技公司的两倍多，其中高影响力漏洞的披露量增加了约150%，并且这些公司修复漏洞的速度与之前相同。由于获得该技术的公司能够自行发现更多漏洞，那些通过漏洞赏金计划出售发现结果的外部研究人员在处理这些公司的代码时发现的漏洞数量减少了一半，而在其他公司的代码中发现的漏洞数量却增加了。没有证据表明攻击者利用了这些新增的漏洞：在漏洞被披露后的一个月内，被利用的漏洞比例下降了约三分之二，主要是因为在披露时已有部分漏洞被利用，而实际被利用的漏洞数量并未发生变化。前沿人工智能技术确实帮助防御者更快地发现并修复了漏洞，但其有限的推广范围导致了不同国家公司之间的软件安全状况存在差异。。

papers.title: Weak Atomic Continuity and Subgame Perfection
papers.abstract: Subgame-perfect equilibrium need not exist in continuous games with perfect information when Nature moves. Under standard regularity assumptions, we prove that weak atomic continuity of Nature's transition probabilities yields a measurable pure-strategy subgame-perfect equilibrium for finite and infinite horizons. The condition, originating in the population genetics literature, is necessary for the existence of subgame-perfect equilibrium uniformly over the remaining primitives: whenever this condition is violated, one can construct a dynamic game with no subgame-perfect equilibrium, even in behavioral strategies. The proof preserves compactness and upper hemicontinuity of continuation payoff correspondences under integration without requiring convexity.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在具有完美信息的连续博弈中，当“自然”（即博弈中的随机因素）进行选择时，子博弈完美均衡可能并不存在。在标准的规则性假设下，我们证明了如果“自然”的转移概率具有弱原子连续性（即转移概率在任意小的邻域内都是连续的），那么无论博弈的期限是有限的还是无限的，都存在一个可测量的纯策略子博弈完美均衡。这一条件最初来源于群体遗传学领域，它是确保所有剩余博弈元素上子博弈完美均衡存在的必要条件：只要这一条件被违反，即使采用行为策略，也可以构造出一个不存在子博弈完美均衡的动态博弈。我们的证明在不需要凸性的情况下，保持了连续支付函数的紧凑性和上半连续性，并且能够在积分过程中保持这些性质。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Hard to Fool: A Bounded LLM Research Loop for Quantitative Finance, and What Two Dozen Campaigns Found
papers.abstract: Agentic research loops that let a language model propose a change, run a fixed experiment and keep whatever improves the metric work well in machine learning. In trading research the same loop is a machine for producing false discoveries: a backtest that "improves the metric" is, by default, overfit, look-ahead, a multiple-comparisons artifact, cost-free, or market drift wearing a strategy. We describe Autonomous Quant Researcher, an open-source loop built on the opposite premise: the model proposes, and only trusted code decides. Proposals are strict declarative JSON over a fixed vocabulary, so there is no model-written code to sandbox. Evaluation runs on immutable chronological stores split into discovery, validation and a final holdout that can be opened exactly once, after a durable receipt is written. Acceptance is a conjunction of absolute gates (positive edge and net P&L after costs, a positive weekly-cluster bootstrap lower bound, survival at elevated costs, per-year stability and sample floors), never a single score. Duplicates are refused before they spend a trial, and every formulation, refusal, crash and result is kept in a hash-chained, append-only ledger. We report every campaign run to date, across 0DTE options priced from traded option bars, overnight SPX verticals, daily ETF rules, technical-analysis premises, Kalshi crypto binaries, earnings options, off-exchange volume and a pre-registered alternative-data campaign. Most hypotheses fail, and we report them. Two results survive their pre-registered bars. The clearest example of the loop working is a failure: a language-model survivor that passed discovery and validation with Sharpe ratios near 3 and fell to 0.26 on its single holdout use. The value of such a loop lies less in what it finds than in how hard it is to make it report something that is not there.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在机器学习中，一种有效的研究机制是：语言模型提出修改方案，然后执行固定实验，并保留所有能够提升评估指标（如“metric”）的修改内容。然而在交易研究中，这种机制却可能被滥用，成为产生错误结论的工具：那些看似“改善了评估指标”的回测结果，往往源于过度拟合、前瞻性分析、多重比较的误差、无实际成本的假设，或是市场环境的变化对策略的影响。我们提出了“Autonomous Quant Researcher”（自主量化研究员）这一开源工具，其设计理念与此截然相反：模型仅提出修改建议，最终是否采纳这些建议由经过严格验证的代码来决定。所有修改提案都以结构化的JSON格式表达，且必须遵循固定的词汇表，从而避免了模型自动生成代码可能带来的问题。评估过程基于不可篡改的时间序列数据，数据被分为三个阶段：发现阶段、验证阶段以及最终的独立验证阶段（该阶段的数据仅在生成可靠验证结果后才能被访问）。评估标准包括多个方面，如绝对收益阈值、扣除成本后的净利润、每周收益的最低要求、在高成本环境下的策略稳定性以及每年的收益稳定性等，而绝非单一的评分标准。任何重复的提案在尝试执行前都会被拒绝，所有的修改过程、拒绝结果、...。研究方法：机器学习、实验方法。

papers.title: Approximate minimax regret for conditionally similar tests
papers.abstract: We construct approximately minimax regret optimal tests in a scalar Gaussian instrumental variables experiment. This example shows how conditionally similar tests allow a novel approximation approach, allowing us to optimize weights over alternatives to minimize worst-case power regret. Stochastic mirror descent and averaging yield finite-iteration guarantees with exact conditional similarity. We establish bounds for exact and simulated powers and illustrate the procedure numerically. This initial algorithm shows how existing nearly-optimal test computation methods can be extended to include composite alternative hypothesis sets without the computational cost associated with maintaining size control.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们在一个标量高斯工具变量实验中构建了近似极小极大遗憾最优检验。这个例子展示了条件相似的检验如何提供一种新的近似方法，使我们能够优化不同检验的权重，以最小化最坏情况下的检验功效遗憾。随机镜像下降（Stochastic Mirror Descent）和平均化技术能够保证在有限迭代次数内获得精确的条件相似性结果。我们建立了精确检验功效和模拟检验功效的界限，并通过数值方法对这一过程进行了验证。这一初步算法表明，现有的近似最优检验计算方法可以扩展到包含复合备择假设集的情况，而无需承担维持样本量控制所带来的计算成本。。研究方法：工具变量、实验方法、随机过程。
